semiconductor_relevance: Medium — the company provides power supply solutions that support semiconductor applications but does not directly manufacture semiconductor devices.
summary: SUN-EH Electric specializes in AC/DC converters and high-voltage DC/DC converters, focusing on providing stable and reliable power supply solutions for various applications in the semiconductor industry. Their products are designed to support the evolving needs of sectors such as photovoltaic systems, EV charging, and industrial automation.
capabilities: Power supply solutions for data centers
